newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qld Cotton climbs after strong half.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qld Cotton climbs after strong half.

text.p: The shares of Australia's largest ginner and marketer of cotton, Queensland Cotton Holdings Ltd, rose strongly on Tuesday after the company reported a big increase in its first half profit on Monday.
At 11.50 a.m. (0150 GMT), Queensland Cotton shares were 35 cents or 9.6 percent higher at A$4.00 on volume of 149,212 shares.
On Monday, the company said its net profit for the six months to August 31 rose 67 percent to A$10.55 million on sales of A$268.3 million.
"I believe the company's share rise this morning also reflects its good earnings outlook," a Brisbane-based dealer said.

On Monday, Queensland Cotton's chairman, Ben Macdonald said the company was looking for further growth in its merchandising division for the second half as excellent agronomic conditions provided an ideal market.
